# VDO.Ninja SDK 1.5.5

This directory vendors the official VDO.Ninja SDK release tagged `v1.5.5` from <https://github.com/steveseguin/ninjasdk> for static, local loading by Spatial Study 6 WebXR. The lightweight tag resolves to commit `d4487b148416524f4b4d7286cfcd407abd4b1c1b`.

Files copied without modification:

| File | Upstream path | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vdoninja-sdk.js` | `vdoninja-sdk.js` | `8097d5420d7ed2426623d7ff08f6abd45f03f89e6540a6cc4b86bcdc057d841e` |
| `LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt` | `LICENSE` | `3f3d9e0024b1921b067d6f7f88deb4a60cbe7a78e76c64e3f1d7fc3b779b9d04` |

The SDK is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Spatial Study 6's independently written TypeScript adapter in `src/companion/` remains under the repository's AGPL-3.0-only license.

The hashes above are over the exact upstream LF bytes. `.gitattributes` pins the SDK, license, and this notice to LF so Windows checkouts preserve reproducible provenance and SRI inputs.
